mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_session (user_id, title, source, context_page) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{source}, #{contextPage})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_session WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_session SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_session SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ai_session SET updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM ai_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source = #{source} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_message (session_id, seq, role, content, raw_tool_calls, tool_call_id, actor_user_id, actor_role_snapshot, source, context_json, model, latency_ms, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{role}, #{content}, #{rawToolCalls}, #{toolCallId}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorRoleSnapshot}, #{source}, #{contextJson}, #{model}, #{latencyMs}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY seq ASC, id ASC
SELECT MAX(seq) FROM ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT DISTINCT tool_call_id FROM ai_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND role = 'tool' AND tool_call_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_interaction (session_id, message_id, tool_call_id, token, kind, question, options_json, status) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{toolCallId}, #{token}, #{kind}, #{question}, #{optionsJson}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_interaction SET chosen_value = #{chosenValue}, status = #{status}, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE token = #{token} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_attachment (session_id, user_id, message_id, kind, filename, sheet_count, row_count, col_count, truncated, note, grid_json) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{messageId}, #{kind}, #{filename}, #{sheetCount}, #{rowCount}, #{colCount}, #{truncated}, #{note}, #{gridJson})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_attachment WHERE message_id IN #{it} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT * FROM ai_attachment WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_tool_call_log (session_id, message_id, tool_name, raw_arguments, required_capability, capability_granted, denial_reason, executed, raw_result, ok, error_message, confirmed_by) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{messageId}, #{toolName}, #{rawArguments}, #{requiredCapability}, #{capabilityGranted}, #{denialReason}, #{executed}, #{rawResult}, #{ok}, #{errorMessage}, #{confirmedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_tool_call_log WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT l.id AS id, l.created_at AS createdAt, s.user_id AS userId, (SELECT m3.actor_role_snapshot FROM ai_message m3 WHERE m3.session_id = l.session_id AND m3.role = 'user' AND (m.seq IS NULL OR m3.seq <= m.seq) ORDER BY m3.seq DESC LIMIT 1) AS actorRoleSnapshot, l.session_id AS sessionId, s.title AS sessionTitle, (SELECT m2.content FROM ai_message m2 WHERE m2.session_id = l.session_id AND m2.role = 'user' AND (m.seq IS NULL OR m2.seq <= m.seq) ORDER BY m2.seq DESC LIMIT 1) AS userUtterance, l.tool_name AS toolName, l.raw_arguments AS rawArguments, l.required_capability AS requiredCapability, l.capability_granted AS capabilityGranted, l.denial_reason AS denialReason, l.executed AS executed, l.raw_result AS rawResult, l.ok AS ok, l.error_message AS errorMessage, l.confirmed_by AS confirmedBy FROM ai_tool_call_log l JOIN ai_session s ON s.id = l.session_id LEFT JOIN ai_message m ON m.id = l.message_id
ORDER BY l.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_tool_call_log l JOIN ai_session s ON s.id = l.session_id
SELECT DISTINCT tool_name FROM ai_tool_call_log ORDER BY tool_name
